Rank 19 - Wholesale

Distributor Due Collection and Sales Rep App

Wholesalers care about route orders, shop dues, collection receipts, and sales rep accountability.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 20,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 1,000Recommended monthly charge

BDT 1,000/month is realistic because receivables are direct cash-flow pain.

7.2Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 20,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 1,000Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 16,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target wholesalers, FMCG distributors, bakery suppliers, water delivery operators, and route sellers.

Sales reps collect cash and orders in notebooks. Owner sees overdue shops late.

Know which shop owes money and which rep collected today.

Validation signals

  • Wholesalers have higher willingness to pay.
  • Receivables hurt cash flow.
  • Rep accountability is owner-visible.
  • Per-user pricing can grow.

MVP modules

  • Customer/shop list
  • Route plan
  • Order entry
  • Due ledger
  • Collection receipt
  • Rep daily report
  • Owner dashboard

Do not build first

  • Do not build full distribution ERP.
  • Do not add warehouse automation first.
  • Do not customize every route rule.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Choose one vertical.
  • Pilot with 2-5 reps.
  • Make receipt excellent.
  • Add route analytics later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Longer sales cycle.
  • Customization pressure.
  • Rep adoption.
Mitigations
  • Charge implementation.
  • Start one vertical.
  • Simple rep app.
